listing.name: Maintenance Revamp
listing.summary: This mini-mod comes with a few custom maintenence cost reduction hullmods costing 0 OP to apply. This is 100% intentional, as I've wanted to be able to balance supply usage myself on a ship-by-ship basis, and now you can too! Self-moderation required for every hullmod here of course.
listing.aiSummary: Adds zero-OP hullmods that reduce maintenance costs by customizable percentages.
listing.partOfThreadTitle: [0.95a-RC15] Hullmod Barratry 2.0 (0.98a RC8 compat, see latest post)

description: This mini-mod comes with a few custom maintenence cost reduction hullmods costing 0 OP to apply. This is 100% intentional, as I've wanted to be able to balance supply usage myself on a ship-by-ship basis, and now you can too! Self-moderation required for every hullmod here of course. Comes in tiers of 30%, 50%, 75% and 95% and only one variety can be installed at one time (includes vanilla Efficiency Overhaul in the limitations). Now includes two new mods, Drive Field Stabiliser EX for when you want to go on a cruise, and High Res Sensors EX made to streamline deep sector scavving.
